# rustinion_remote_access_policy (Resource)

Manages the remote access settings (remote desktop, each remote-access channel, and the remote terminal as its own separate setting) at one level of the hierarchy: the organization, a group or a device. A value is inherit, on or off; a setting applies to everything below it unless a lower level sets its own, except that a locked setting binds everything below. You can only change what your API key's organization owns; a lock set by the platform cannot be changed here. Channels not listed are left alone; removing a channel from the configuration (or destroying the resource) puts it back to inherit. The read-only effective and why maps show the resolved answer and which level decided it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope` (String) `tenant` (your organization), `group` or `device`.

### Optional

- `channels` (Attributes Map) Channel name -> setting. Channels: `terminal`, `desktop`, `clipboard`, `files`, `drive`, `print`, `usb`, `audio`, `mic`, `recording`, `unattended`, `secure_desktop`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels))
- `scope_id` (String) The group or device id (omit for `tenant`).

### Read-Only

- `effective` (Map of Boolean) Channel -> is it effectively on for this scope (after inheritance, locks and the dependency on the desktop).
- `id` (String) `<scope>:<scope_id>`.
- `why` (Map of String) Channel -> one sentence saying which level decided.

<a id="nestedatt--channels"></a>
### Nested Schema for `channels`

Required:

- `value` (String) `inherit`, `on` or `off`.

Optional:

- `locked` (Boolean) Lock the value for everything below (needs `on` or `off`; not available on a device).
